name: HeroUI v3 Storybook & Testing Patterns

upstream.licenseNote: Repository root contains Apache-2.0 terms while @heroui/react package metadata declares MIT. Verify the applicable upstream notice when copying source; prefer package installation where possible.

principles: Treat Storybook stories as interaction/state examples rather than visual templates to clone.
Preserve React Aria keyboard, focus, selection and overlay semantics when adapting HeroUI behavior.
Test accessible role/name before visual details for interactive primitives.
Expose state to styling through semantic data attributes such as hovered, pressed, focus-visible and disabled.
Test disabled behavior as behavior, not only appearance.
For compound components, test the assembled interaction contract as well as individual slots.
For data components, test sorting, selection and accessible grid/table labeling against realistic data.
SSR-sensitive primitives should have server-render coverage where the upstream component has it.

behaviorContract: keyboard activation with Enter and Space
